fullDescription: A cozy, editorial three-tier SaaS pricing page in a cream-and-clay palette with a serif display headline, a highlighted dark center tier, a monthly/yearly toggle, and a friendly FAQ.

structured.summary: A warm, editorial three-tier SaaS pricing page with an inviting cream-and-clay palette, a serif display headline, and a highlighted dark center tier. Reads like a friendly indie product, not a corporate billing screen. Frameless responsive web page: sticky translucent nav, soft-gradient hero with a monthly/yearly toggle, a 3-tier card grid that reflows 3->2->1 columns, a trust strip, a FAQ accordion, and a dark footer.

style.description: Cozy, hand-warm editorial aesthetic. Off-white cream paper background with a faint grain dot-texture, warm clay/sand neutrals, and a single punchy ember-orange accent for CTAs and emphasis. A Fraunces serif carries all headlines and prices for a boutique feel; Inter handles body copy. Soft, generous rounding (rounded-3xl cards, rounded-full pills/buttons), gentle multi-layer shadows, and a warm-tinted lift shadow on hover. Forest-green is used only for positive checkmarks and reassurance icons.
style.prompt: Build a warm, friendly, editorial light theme. Palette (exact hex): page background cream #FBF6EF, secondary surface sand #F3EADC, soft border clay #E8DCC9, primary text/ink #2A2520, muted text mocha #6B5D4F, accent ember #E8623D with darker hover emberdark #D14E2B, soft accent tint peach #FBEAE2, positive/green leaf #5C8A6B; cards use translucent white (white at ~70% opacity) on the cream background. Fonts: display 'Fraunces' (serif, weights 400-700, used for h1/h2/h3 and the big price numbers) and body 'Inter' (sans, weights 400-700) loaded from Google Fonts. Add a subtle paper-grain texture via a radial-gradient dot pattern (rgba(42,37,32,0.025) 1px dots on a 4px grid) behind the hero and FAQ. Rounding is soft and generous: rounded-3xl (24px) on pricing cards, rounded-2xl on FAQ rows, rounded-full on pills/badges/buttons, rounded-xl on the small icon chips. Two custom shadows: 'soft' (0 1px 2px rgba(42,37,32,0.04), 0 8px 24px rgba(42,37,32,0.06)) at rest and a warm 'lift' (0 2px 4px rgba(42,37,32,0.05), 0 18px 48px rgba(232,98,61,0.16)) on hover. Use Phosphor (ph:) duotone/fill icons throughout. Voice is warm and human ('No surprises, promise', 'A friendly human, on call'), never corporate.

layout_and_structure.description: Single centered column capped at max-w-6xl (FAQ narrows to max-w-3xl), all sections frameless and full-bleed in background color. Top to bottom: sticky translucent nav, centered hero with badge + serif headline + billing toggle, a 3-tier pricing card grid with the middle tier highlighted and visually lifted, a centered trust/reassurance strip, a FAQ accordion section on a sand background, and a dark footer. Fully responsive: pricing grid is 3 columns on desktop, 2 columns on tablet (with the highlighted card spanning), and a single stacked column on mobile; nav links collapse on small screens.

prompts.prompt: Sticky top nav (sticky top-0, z-50) on a translucent cream background (cream at ~85% opacity) with backdrop-blur and a thin clay bottom border, height ~68px, inner content capped at max-w-6xl with px-6. Left: logo lockup = a rounded-xl ember square chip holding a white ph:sparkle-fill icon, next to the wordmark 'Promptly' in Fraunces ~20px. Center (hidden on mobile): text links Library, Templates, Pricing (active, ink), FAQ in mocha ~15px that darken to ink on hover. Right: a muted 'Log in' text link plus a solid ink pill button 'Start free' with a ph:arrow-right icon that flips to ember background on hover.

Centered hero on cream with grain texture and two large blurred soft-color orbs (one peach top-left, one sand top-right) bleeding in behind the content. Stack centered: a small pill badge (peach background, emberdark text, ember/15 ring) reading 'Loved by 40,000+ makers' with a ph:heart-straight-fill icon; then a Fraunces serif headline ~44-58px, tight leading, 'Pricing that grows right alongside you.'; then a mocha subhead ~18px max-w-xl: 'A whole library of beautiful, ready-to-remix design prompts. Start free, upgrade when you're ready, cancel anytime. No surprises, promise.' Below, a billing toggle (see special components) flanked by a leaf-green 'Save 20%' tag with a ph:tag-fill icon.

Three pricing cards in a grid (gap-6, lg:grid-cols-3, md:grid-cols-2, single column on mobile) with items-stretch so heights match. Each card: rounded-3xl, p-8, a small rounded-xl icon chip + Fraunces tier name, a one-line mocha tagline, the price in big Fraunces ~46px with a small '/period' suffix and a tiny billing note line, a full-width pill CTA, then a checklist (ph:check-bold icons in leaf-green, ~14.5px rows). Tier 1 'Starter' $0/forever (sand chip, ph:leaf-fill), outline CTA 'Get started free', features: 50 prompts, 5 collections, community templates, email support. Tier 2 'Maker' $19/month (HIGHLIGHTED): solid dark ink background with cream text, ember icon chip (ph:rocket-launch-fill), an ember 'Most loved' star ribbon badge pinned to the top edge, ember checkmarks, a solid ember CTA 'Start 14-day trial', and on desktop it sits slightly raised (negative top margin) with the lift shadow; features: unlimited library, unlimited collections, one-click remix & export, Figma & code handoff, priority support. Tier 3 'Studio' $49/month per workspace up to 10 seats (peach chip, ph:buildings-fill), outline CTA 'Talk to us', features: everything in Maker, shared team workspace, brand kits & custom themes, SSO & admin controls, a friendly human on call. Non-highlighted cards are translucent white with a clay ring and soft shadow, and on hover lift up (-translate-y-1), gain the warm lift shadow and an ember/30 ring. On tablet the highlighted card spans both columns and centers; order is rearranged so the highlighted card reads last on tablet but center on desktop.

Below the cards, a centered, wrapping inline row of three reassurance items in mocha ~14px, each with a leaf-green Phosphor icon: '30-day money-back guarantee' (ph:shield-check-fill), 'No card needed to start' (ph:credit-card-fill), 'Cancel anytime' (ph:hand-waving-fill).

FAQ section on a sand background with grain texture and a clay top border, content capped at max-w-3xl. Centered header: a cream pill badge 'Questions?' (ph:chats-circle-fill), a Fraunces heading ~36-42px 'Friendly answers', and a mocha line 'Still curious after this? Ping us, a real human writes back.' Below, a vertical stack (space-y-3) of native <details> accordion rows: each is rounded-2xl, cream background, clay ring, px-6, with a Fraunces ~18px question on the left and a ph:plus icon in ember on the right that rotates 45deg into an x when open (open rows also gain the soft shadow). Default the first item open. Questions (warm tone): 'Can I really start for free?', 'What happens when I upgrade or downgrade?', 'Do you offer team or student discounts?', 'What if it's not for me?'

Dark footer on the ink background with cream/80 text, capped at max-w-6xl, py-14. Left: the ember-chip + 'Promptly' logo lockup over a max-w-sm cream/60 blurb 'A warm little library of design prompts, made by people who'd rather help than upsell.' Right: a small multi-column link grid (Library, Templates, Pricing, Blog, FAQ, Contact). Bottom bar separated by a faint cream/10 top border: '© 2026 Promptly. Made with care.' on the left and Privacy / Terms / 'Follow along' (with ph:x-logo) on the right, all in cream/50 ~13px.

special_ui_components.description: A rounded-full segmented pill switch that swaps every tier's price between monthly and annual values with an animated sliding indicator.
special_ui_components.prompt: Build a rounded-full segmented toggle on a sand background with a clay ring, p-1, two buttons 'Monthly' and 'Yearly'. A sliding ink-colored pill sits behind the active label and animates its left position (transition ~300ms ease-out) between the two segments; active label text is cream, inactive is mocha. Wire it in JS so toggling rewrites each price element from its data-monthly / data-annual attributes (e.g. $19 -> $15, $49 -> $39) and flips the small billing note between 'Billed monthly' and 'Billed yearly', while $0/forever stays fixed. Pair it with a separate leaf-green 'Save 20%' tag (ph:tag-fill) sitting just to the right of the toggle.

special_ui_components.description: The center pricing tier rendered as an inverted dark card that visually pops above its neighbors.
special_ui_components.prompt: Render the middle tier as a solid dark ink card with cream text (instead of translucent white), carrying an ember 'Most loved' ribbon badge (uppercase, ph:star-fill) pinned overlapping its top edge, an ember icon chip, ember checkmarks, and a solid ember CTA. On large screens raise it slightly with a negative top margin and apply the warm ember-tinted lift shadow so it reads as the recommended plan; on tablet have it span the full two-column width and center.

special_ui_components.description: Small rounded square badges that hold a single Phosphor icon, used per tier and in the logo.
special_ui_components.prompt: Create small ~36px rounded-xl square chips that center a single Phosphor fill icon, color-coded per context: ember chip with cream icon for the logo and the highlighted tier, sand chip with mocha icon for Starter, peach chip with emberdark icon for Studio. Used in the logo lockup and as each tier's header glyph.

structured.special_notes: Frameless, fully responsive web page (not a fixed-frame mockup): max-w-6xl centered container with px-6 gutters, sections full-bleed in their background color. Pricing grid reflows 3 -> 2 -> 1 columns and nav links collapse on mobile. Sticky translucent backdrop-blur nav. Built with Tailwind (CDN) using a custom warm color/shadow theme, Fraunces + Inter from Google Fonts, and Phosphor (ph:) icons via iconify-icon. The billing toggle and FAQ accordion are interactive (small vanilla JS + native <details>). Keep the voice warm and human everywhere; avoid em-dashes.
